We have two levers here: 1) request an exception from AWS (takes 7-10 business days, may need exec sponsorship) or 2) publish at list and use a private-offer discount via the private-offer flow (still appears to AWS as a valid listing but we must document the discount).

Asking Deal Desk for internal approval to: waive our internal minimum-publish threshold for Retail Delta for a 6-month pilot and allow the private offer at 18% off. This will require a Marketplace Concession Exception ticket and sign-off from Sales Ops / Finance.

I attached the AWS_private_offer_template and marked the fields we'd override. Also calling out that if AWS insists on minimum quarterly invoicing, procurement might push back.
